title: drain_once dead/ metrics scan breaks on first entry error
description: In drain_once, the dead/ directory scan (lines 341-352) uses 'Err(e) => { warn\!(...); break; }' on next_entry() errors. A single bad directory entry aborts the count, leaving dead_count understated. set_relay_dead_letter_depth will silently report fewer files than actually exist. Under the round-6 fix the outer Err arm now logs a warning (correct), but the inner per-entry error still breaks rather than continuing — the metric becomes wrong silently. Same structural bug as in the cleanup scans.
